"""Receive original bodies and exact public recipe from the single owned wheel."""
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import resource
import subprocess
import sys
import sysconfig
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ROOT=CASE.parents[1]
PLAN=json.loads((CASE/'installed_context_plan.json').read_text())
BUILD=json.loads((CASE/'owned_build.json').read_text())
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_DATA,(536870912,536870912))
assert sys.flags.isolated and sys.flags.no_site and sys.dont_write_bytecode
assert os.sched_getaffinity(0)=={19} and os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS,0)==19
memory=Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text();pressure=Path('/proc/pressure/memory').read_text()
assert int(next(x.split()[1] for x in memory.splitlines() if x.startswith('MemAvailable:')))>2*1024*1024
assert all(float(x.split('avg10=')[1].split()[0])<1 for x in pressure.splitlines())
assert Path.cwd()==Path(PLAN['cwd']) and not Path.cwd().is_relative_to(ROOT)
config={'target':PLAN['target'],'fixtures':PLAN['fixtures'],
    'forbidden_roots':[str(ROOT),str(CASE/'source')],
    'admitted_roots':[PLAN['target'],PLAN['fixtures'],*PLAN['explicit_provider_roots'],PLAN['site_packages']],
    'provider_mapping':{name:value for row in PLAN['editable_mapping_declarations'] for name,value in row['mapping'].items()},
    'search_roots':[PLAN['target'],PLAN['fixtures'],PLAN['site_packages']],
    'stdlib_roots':[sysconfig.get_path('stdlib'),str(Path(sysconfig.get_path('stdlib')).parent/'python314.zip')],
    'control_files':[str(p) for p in (CASE/'controls').glob('*.py')],
    'base_sys_path':list(sys.path),'shared_sdk':PLAN['shared_sdk']}
boundary_source=(CASE/'controls/boundary.py').read_text()
exec(compile(boundary_source,str(CASE/'controls/boundary.py'),'exec'))
guard=_ReceivingBoundary(config)
sys.meta_path.insert(0,guard)


def identity(path):
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):digest.update(block)
    return dict(bytes=Path(path).stat().st_size,sha256=digest.hexdigest())


def provider_files():
    result={}
    for row in PLAN['editable_mapping_declarations']:
        for name,value in row['mapping'].items():
            p=Path(value)
            result[name]={str(x.relative_to(p)) if p.is_dir() else x.name:identity(x)
                for x in (sorted(p.rglob('*.py')) if p.is_dir() else [p])}
    return result


providers_before=provider_files()
native_root=Path(config['provider_mapping']['molsysmt'])
native_before={str(p.relative_to(native_root)):identity(p) for p in sorted(native_root.rglob('*.so'))}
assert native_before['_rust.abi3.so']['sha256']=='2a79b9a83b0fe0b00a54c9b80f04bf6c9ace2b3473c53269edbfe29904f8930b'
for name,wanted in PLAN['fixture_files'].items():assert identity(Path(PLAN['fixtures'])/name)==wanted
for name,wanted in BUILD['runtime_files_equal'].items():assert identity(Path(PLAN['target'])/name)==wanted
assert identity(Path(BUILD['wheel']['path']))=={key:BUILD['wheel'][key] for key in ('bytes','sha256')}
import pharmacophoremt as phmt
import pharmacophoremt_results
assert Path(phmt.__file__).resolve()==Path(PLAN['target'])/'pharmacophoremt/__init__.py'
assert phmt.__version__==BUILD['version']==importlib.metadata.version('pharmacophoremt')
import pytest
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(PLAN['fixtures'])/'tests'))
import test_public_run_results as fixture
children=[]


def fresh(self,source,*arguments):
    number=len(children)
    report=CASE/f'installed-child-{number}.json'
    bootstrap=boundary_source+'\n'+'''
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
_config=json.loads(sys.argv.pop(1))
_report=Path(sys.argv.pop(1))
_source=sys.argv.pop(1)
_guard=_ReceivingBoundary(_config)
sys.meta_path.insert(0,_guard)
try:
    exec(compile(_source,'<original isolated reader child>','exec'))
finally:
    _report.write_text(json.dumps(_guard.snapshot(),indent=2)+'\\n')
'''
    child=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-S','-B','-c',bootstrap,json.dumps(config),str(report),
        fixture.FRESH_GUARD+source,str(fixture.ROOT),*map(str,arguments)],cwd=PLAN['cwd'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30,check=False)
    assert report.is_file(),child.stderr
    streams={}
    for name,text in [('stdout',child.stdout),('stderr',child.stderr)]:
        path=CASE/f'installed-child-{number}.{name}';path.write_text(text);streams[name]=identity(path)
    children.append(dict(index=number,exit_code=child.returncode,guard=report.name,guard_identity=identity(report),streams=streams))
    (CASE/'installed_children.json').write_text(json.dumps(children,indent=2)+'\n')
    return child


fixture.TestPublicRunResults.fresh=fresh
class Admission:
    def pytest_sessionstart(self,session):
        sys.meta_path.remove(guard);sys.meta_path.insert(0,guard)


import ackredit as ack
from contextlib import ExitStack
from tests import test_saved_run_comparison as analytical
left_generator=analytical.saved.__wrapped__()
left_fixture=next(left_generator)
pair_generator=analytical.paired.__wrapped__(left_fixture)
pair=next(pair_generator)
try:
    before=pair.left.directory_bytes(),pair.right.directory_bytes()
    with ExitStack() as stack:
        left,right=analytical.open_pair(stack,pair)
        with ack.session("enclosing paired application") as application:
            with ack.capture("paired saved-run analysis") as capture,phmt.attribution():
                result=analytical.compare(pair.cohort,left,right)
            assert ack.current_session() is application
    assert (pair.left.directory_bytes(),pair.right.directory_bytes())==before
    references=capture.attribution.to_dict()
    encoded=json.dumps(references)
    assert result['attribution']['status']=='captured'
    assert 'validation.screening_runs.compare_screening_runs' in encoded
    assert 'validation.metrics.bedroc' in encoded
    assert 'never credit this saved source' not in encoded
    assert result['arms']['baseline']['records'][1]['outcome']['native_result']['attribution']==pair.left.native['alpha']['attribution']
    assert providers_before==provider_files()
    assert native_before=={str(p.relative_to(native_root)):identity(p) for p in sorted(native_root.rglob('*.so'))}
    snapshot=guard.snapshot()
    payload=dict(schema='pharmacophoremt.paired-saved-run-attribution@1',source_commit=BUILD['source_commit'],wheel=BUILD['wheel'],version=BUILD['version'],result=result,references=references,application_session_preserved=True,original_bytes_and_source_attribution_preserved=True,provider_python_native_files_unchanged=True,forbidden_import_attempts=snapshot['forbidden_import_attempts'],scope='Real optional Ackredit for one exact installed six-sample paired saved-format analysis. Full portable graph retained; no new independent guard, molecular computation, biological validity or public dependency solve.')
    (CASE/'installed_attribution.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(items=len(references.get('items',[])),uses=len(references.get('uses',[])),captured=True)),flush=True)
finally:
    pair_generator.close()
    left_generator.close()

launch_attribution.py.content:
"""Bounded launcher; preserve every attempt without rebuilding the wheel."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

CASE=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
build=json.loads((CASE/'owned_build.json').read_text())
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_DATA,(536870912,536870912))
assert os.sched_getaffinity(0)=={19} and os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS,0)==19
number=len(list(CASE.glob('attribution-attempt*-command.json')))+1
args=[sys.executable,'-I','-S','-B',str(CASE/'controls/receive_attribution.py')]
log=CASE/f'attribution-attempt{number}.log'
env={key:value for key,value in os.environ.items() if key not in {'PYTHONPATH','PYTHONSTARTUP','COVERAGE_PROCESS_START','COVERAGE_PROCESS_CONFIG'} and not key.startswith('COV_CORE_')}
env['PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD']='1'
env['PYTEST_ADDOPTS']=''
env['PHMT_RECEIVING_ATTEMPT']=str(number)
start=time.monotonic()
with log.open('xb') as output:
    run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time','-v','-o',str(CASE/f'attribution-attempt{number}-resources.txt'),*args],cwd=build['cwd'],env=env,stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=180,check=False)
raw=log.read_bytes()
record={'arguments':args,'cwd':build['cwd'],'exit_code':run.returncode,
    'seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'log':log.name,
    'log_identity':{'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},
    'wheel':build['wheel'],'version':build['version'],'source':build['source_commit']}
(CASE/f'attribution-attempt{number}-command.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
print(log.read_text()[-5000:],flush=True)
raise SystemExit(run.returncode)
